snippet.title: Roll The Bones - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
“Roll The Bones” is a solo developed fast-paced roguelite mixing fantasy theme with dice-rolling mechanics and arcade elements. Releasing on Steam in late 2025.

🎲 Wishlist “Roll The Bones” on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527550/Roll_The_Bones/ 

Trailer music: “Underdog” by DAVIS (@unofficialdavis)
Trailer edited by: David Korejtko
Game created by: Luke Kabat

[ 🎮] Join Shrimp Industries discord: https://discord.com/invite/rnuNPCnGDK 
[ 👉] For more info, presskit and assets visit: http://shrimp.industries
[  𝕏  ] For more updates, follow me on Twitter/X: https://x.com/ShrimpInd 

For additional content about Roll The Bones, game development and various random gameplays and shenanigans, consider subscribing to Shrimp Industries youtube channel ^^

Feel free to leave comments and feedback under this youtube video, game is still in development and all the early feedback is crucial in making it better :)
